newsitem.title: GERMANY: Delta adds US-Europe fuel surcharge.
newsitem.headline: Delta adds US-Europe fuel surcharge.

text.p: Delta Air Lines said it will introduce a 10 cents per kilo cargo fuel surcharge on all flights between the USA and Europe with effect from Friday November 15.
The surcharge also applies to inner-Europe flights and services between the U.S. and India, an airline statement issued here said.
In a letter to European clients, Danita Waterfall, cargo sales director Europe, said Delta had avoided passing on increased fuel costs to date.
"However, with fuel prices now at 25 percent more than the same period last year, we have no alternative but to apply a fuel surcharge effective November 15," she said.
The airline would revise the surcharge when fuel prices returned to acceptable levels, she added.
